down.n: Jadzi, Steward of Fate // Oracle's Gift

30.brief: Izzet Prowess still leads Pioneer at 14%, with Golgari Midrange close behind at 12%. Storm the Festival gained 5.1 pts while Izzet Lessons fell 7.1 pts. Gran-Gran has all but vanished, down to 0.9% of decks.

bans.brief: Pioneer opened up after Cori-Steel Cutter's ban: Mono-Red Aggro climbed to 11% and Dimir Midrange reached 7.5%. Izzet Phoenix grew from 1.2% to 7.5%, now built around Proft's Eidetic Memory. The shares haven't settled yet.
